Getting here

  • From San Francisco — 2 hr 30 min via Highway 1, or 2 hr 45 min the inland way through Santa Rosa, which is faster in fog.
  • From Santa Rosa — 90 minutes west on 116 and north on 1.
  • The last 40 minutes have no cell service. Download the route before you leave Jenner.
  • Parking is free and on site. There are two EV chargers.

Questions we get.

Check-in is from 16:00, check-out is 11:00. Arrive earlier and we will take your bags and point you at the courtyard or the bluff trail.

Two nights on Friday and Saturday between June and September. Single nights are available every other night of the year.

Cancel more than 7 days before arrival for a full refund. Inside that window the first night is charged.

Yes, in the Cliff Houses, which have the space and the second bathroom. The restaurant seats children at the 19:00 service.

One dog per Cliff House, no charge. The bluff trail is a working conservation easement, so dogs stay leashed on it.

Two and a half hours from San Francisco on Highway 1, or ninety minutes from Santa Rosa. The last forty minutes have no cell service — download the directions.
